A new chapter of service, leadership, and impactful community initiatives begins! 🌟

Rotaract Club of Baneshwor successfully hosted its 7th Installation Ceremony on Saturday, July 25, 2026, at Apex College, Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu. 

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Immediate Past President Rtr. Rashmi Timalsina and the RY 2025/26 team for their remarkable leadership and dedication. At the same time, we warmly welcome President Rtr. Prashanna Gautam and the Board of Directors for Rota Year 2026/27 as they step into this exciting new journey!

"Small Acts. Real Changes. Making a Big Difference."

--------------------------------------------------
📍 Event Details:
• Date: Saturday, July 25, 2026
• Venue: Apex College, Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu
• Immediate Past President: Rtr. Rashmi Timalsina (RY 2026/27)
• President: Rtr. Prashanna Gautam (RY 2026/27)

🌾🥣 खिर खाने दिनको शुभकामना!

नेपाली संस्कृतिमा साउन १५ केवल खिर खाने दिन मात्र होइन, हाम्रो कृषि परम्परा, परिवारको एकता र प्रकृतिप्रतिको कृतज्ञताको प्रतीक पनि हो।

धान रोपाइँको कठिन परिश्रमपछि परिवार, आफन्त र साथीभाइसँग बसेर मिठो खिरको स्वाद साट्नु भनेको खुसी, समृद्धि र आत्मीयताको उत्सव मनाउनु हो।

यस पावन अवसरले सबैको जीवनमा सुख, शान्ति, स्वास्थ्य र समृद्धि ल्याओस् भन्ने शुभकामना व्यक्त गर्दछौं।

रोटर्याक्ट क्लब अफ बानेश्वर परिवारको तर्फबाट सम्पूर्णमा "खिर खाने दिन" को हार्दिक शुभकामना! 💙

🚫 World Day Against Trafficking in Persons | 30 July

Human trafficking is a grave violation of human rights that strips individuals of their freedom, dignity, and future. Millions of women, men, and children around the world continue to be exploited through forced labor, sexual exploitation, child trafficking, forced marriage, and other forms of abuse.

On this World Day Against Trafficking in Persons, the Rotaract Club of Baneshwor stands in solidarity with survivors and joins the global call to raise awareness, protect the vulnerable, and hold traffickers accountable.

Every person deserves to live with freedom, safety, and dignity. Together, through awareness, education, and collective action, we can help build communities where exploitation has no place.

End Human Trafficking. Protect Human Dignity. Be the Voice for the Voiceless. 💙

🤝 Happy International Friendship Day! 💙

Friendship is more than shared smiles—it is trust, encouragement, and standing beside one another through every challenge and every success. Together, we grow stronger, inspire positive change, and create lasting memories.

At the Rotaract Club of Baneshwor, we celebrate the friendships that transform teammates into family, volunteers into leaders, and small acts into meaningful impact.

Here's to every friend who listens, supports, inspires, and walks the journey of service together. 🌍✨

"Together, we serve. Together, we grow. Together, we make a difference."

Happy International Friendship Day! 💙
